prompt: Create ONE original cartoon game terrain sprite source: a very long, very shallow horizontal cliff-foot contact fringe, designed to overlay the bottom of a cool grey granite cliff in a front-facing slightly elevated orthographic 2D RPG. This is a terrain connection piece, NOT a row of freestanding boulders, NOT a wall, NOT an island or platform. An irregular continuous skirt of attached grey granite toes, shallow angular fractured ledges and a little subdued earth at ground contact; interlocking rock shapes vary in width and height, no identical repeating chunks, no masonry. Upper edge of the fringe irregularly overlaps a vertical cliff behind it; lower edge meets the ground with small uneven stone projections and a narrow brown-grey dirt edge. Extremely shallow silhouette: approximately TEN TIMES as wide as its maximum height. Avoid large round rocks or tall upright rock columns. Simple clean hand-painted cartoon style with restrained dark grey outlines, broad cool neutral grey faces and upper-left light; not noisy realistic texture, not pixel art, not low-poly 3D. No grass surface, no plants, no water, no props, no shadows outside the sprite, no cast shadow on the green backing. Both left and right endpoints are flat vertical cuts through the same shallow fringe profile, not tapered down to nothing. Entire single fringe centered with generous empty margins on a uniform exact #00FF00 green background; no other objects, no text, no grid lines, no panels. Wide landscape canvas. Keep all rock details inside the one shallow connected sprite. The sprite is a new detachable contact piece to use alongside an existing cliff, not an illustration of a complete cliff.
processing: Uniform calibrated resize and padding; original RGBA retained. Green-backed master is a packaging export over #00FF00; runtime retains alpha.

unusedVariant.reason: Bottom contour too straight; retained, not deleted.
unusedVariant.prompt: OPAQUE BRIGHT GREEN BACKGROUND REQUIRED: make a wide landscape RGB game source sheet whose entire background is flat vivid #00FF00 green. This is a green-screen asset image, not a transparent PNG. Center ONE very long shallow continuous cool-grey granite cliff-foot skirt on that green background. This is a detachable base-contact overlay for a cartoon cliff, with irregular attached rock toes and a narrow muted dirt edge. Sprite width ten times its height, about 90% canvas width. All surrounding space must remain bright green. Broad simple hand-painted cartoon grey stone faces with subdued dark outlines, varied angular low ledges interlocking into a single continuous fringe, upper-left lighting. The top edge has low irregular rock projections to overlap the cliff; bottom edge has uneven tiny stone toes and soil to meet ground. No round boulder piles, no tall wall, no big rock columns, no grass, no plants, no water, no props, no characters. Straight cut-through left and right ends of the strip. No gradients, shadows, black or transparent areas in the BACKGROUND. No labels, no grid, no text, no duplicate rows. Original cartoon 2D front-facing slightly elevated orthographic terrain artwork, not pixel art, not low-poly 3D. Keep only ONE thin horizontal sprite, with generous solid BRIGHT GREEN empty margins.
